input: Look into joining a local credit union

gold.taskTitle: Research and Join a Local Credit Union
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to explore the process of becoming a member of a credit union in their local area.

questions.title: What city or region are you located in?
questions.description: Understanding the user's location to identify relevant local credit unions.

questions.title: What type of account do you primarily need?
questions.description: Determining whether the user needs checking, savings, a loan, or another product.

questions.title: Are you switching from an existing bank or adding a new account?
questions.description: Clarifying whether this replaces a current banking relationship or supplements one.

questions.title: Do you have a specific credit union already in mind?
questions.description: Finding out if the user has already identified a target institution or needs help finding one.

questions.title: Is there a group or employer you belong to that offers membership?
questions.description: Many credit unions require eligibility through an employer, union, or community group.

questions.title: What is your timeline for opening the account?
questions.description: Understanding urgency helps prioritize the steps and set a realistic schedule.

questions.title: Are low fees, high savings rates, or loan options your top priority?
questions.description: Identifying the user's most important financial criteria for choosing a credit union.
